biotools.summary: HCTSA is a tool for highly comparative time series analysis, used to extract features from oxygen saturation and heart rate data in preterm infants to predict respiratory outcomes. It leverages existing code from multiple disciplines and includes documentation and installation instructions on its GitHub repository.
